market.title: Gwinnett and DeKalb County: September 2026 at a glance
market.source: Realtor.com Economic Research county inventory data
paragraphs: Counting pending sales, Gwinnett County had 4,831 total listings in September 2026, with a pending ratio of about 0.25. The median listed home was about 2,562 square feet.
Homes in DeKalb County spent a median of 59 days on the market in September 2026, 10.0% shorter than a year earlier. About 23% of active listings had a price reduction.
The simple version for Gwinnett and DeKalb County: buyers have more homes to compare than they did a year ago, so pricing and condition matter more than ever.
market.verificationNote: Source: Realtor.com Economic Research county inventory data, September 2026 (latest monthly release). Figures are countywide listing data, not closed sales.

rotatingFeatures.label: HOMEOWNER / SEASONAL HOME TIP
rotatingFeatures.title: Check the Cords Before the Lights Go Up
paragraphs: Before the decorations come out of storage, take a few minutes with the extension cords and light strands. UGA Extension's home checklist includes checking for damaged cords and wires and inspecting outlets for safety.
items: Look for cracked insulation, exposed wire, and bent or loose plugs.
Retire any cord that feels warm during normal use.
Avoid plugging too much into a single outlet.
rotatingFeatures.closing: A damaged strand is cheaper to replace than to worry about.
rotatingFeatures.source: Source: UGA Cooperative Extension, Home Maintenance Checklist (C1082).

rotatingFeatures.label: LOCAL COMMUNITY EVENT
rotatingFeatures.title: Snellville's 45th Annual Christmas Lighted Parade
paragraphs: Snellville's annual holiday celebration begins with a lighted parade and continues at Towne Green with family activities, treats, and free visits with Santa.
The organizer lists the parade start at 5:30 PM, with the overall event running from 5 to 8 PM.
rotatingFeatures.closing: Towne Green, 2342 Oak Road, Snellville. Check the official page for parking and activity-ticket details.
rotatingFeatures.source: Source: Experience Snellville, official Lighted Christmas Parade event page.
